title: Canonical exact-square derived-unit arrows
statement: Let $A',A,B',B$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian] with ordinary derived categories and canonical localization $Q_h$ from their homotopy categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Fix additive functors $H':A'\to B'$, $H:A\to B$, exact additive functors $r:A'\to A$, $s:B'\to B$, and a specified equality $h:H's=rH$. Fix functors $RH':D(A')\to D(B')$, $RH:D(A)\to D(B)$ and natural transformations $\eta':H'_hQ_h\to Q_hRH'$, $\eta:H_hQ_h\to Q_hRH$, of the type of right-derived units [def-sfb-right-derived-functor]; no universality or resolution is required to define the following arrows. Define the homotopy comparison $\sigma:r_hH_h\cong H'_hs_h$ by the composition isomorphisms and $h$. For a complex $J$ define $a_J:Q_hH_hr_hJ\to D(s)RH'Q_hJ$ as $Q_h(\sigma_J)$, followed by the inverse exact-localization comparison for $s$ at $H'_hJ$, followed by $D(s)(\eta'_J)$. Define $b_J:Q_hH_hr_hJ\to RH D(r)Q_hJ$ as $\eta_{r_hJ}$ followed by $RH$ of the inverse exact-localization comparison for $r$ at $J$. If $a_J$ is invertible define $\delta_J=a_J^{-1}$ followed by $b_J$. These are the specified arrows, including all exact-localization factors, not independently chosen maps.

def leftUnit (J : CochainComplex A' ℤ) :
    DerivedCategory.Qh.obj ((H.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj
      ((r.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj
        ((HomotopyCategory.quotient A' (.up ℤ)).obj J))) ⟶
      (RH' ⋙ s.mapDerivedCategory).obj
        (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj ((HomotopyCategory.quotient A' (.up ℤ)).obj J))
